steps.name: Close restroom
steps.do: Open **Set restroom as closed**. Choose a restroom, set a date range covering today, and enter a **Closed message** (e.g. **Manual test restroom closed**).
steps.expect: Success that the restroom was set as closed.

steps.name: Map closed behavior
steps.do: From the bottom nav, open **Map**. On **Specific Map**, set the date to today. In **Filter:**, enable **Restrooms**. Try with **Include closed restrooms** unchecked, then checked; with include on, click the restroom marker.
steps.expect: With include off, the restroom marker is absent. With include on, the marker appears; tooltip/banner shows the **Closed message**.

steps.name: Set alert
steps.do: Open **Set restroom alert**. Choose the same restroom, set dates covering today, and enter an alert message (e.g. **Manual test restroom alert**).
steps.expect: Success that the restroom was given an alert.

steps.name: Map while closed with alert
steps.do: Return to **Map** on **Specific Map** today with **Restrooms** enabled and **Include closed restrooms** checked; click the restroom marker.
steps.expect: Tooltip/banner shows the **Closed message** only (no restroom alert badge).

steps.name: Open restroom
steps.do: Open **Set restroom as open**. Choose the same restroom and submit.
steps.expect: Success that the restroom was set as open.

steps.name: Map alert after open
steps.do: Return to **Map** on **Specific Map** today with **Restrooms** enabled and **Include closed restrooms** unchecked. Find the restroom marker and click it.
steps.expect: Restroom alert badge/styling is present; tooltip/banner shows the alert message.

steps.name: Remove alert
steps.do: Open **Remove restroom alert**. Choose the same restroom and submit.
steps.expect: Success that the alert was removed.

steps.name: Map clear
steps.do: Return to **Map** on **Specific Map** today with **Restrooms** enabled; click the restroom marker.
steps.expect: No alert badge; tooltip/banner has no closed or alert message.
